description: Liveline is a real-time line chart control for Uno Platform, drawn with SkiaSharp on an SKCanvasElement. The sample shows one chart on a live feed: a short loading state, then a volatile random walk with a new value every 150 ms. The line, its gradient fill, the value range and the badge ease toward each new value, a live dot marks the latest value, and the chart stops drawing once the line settles.

showcase.summary: A real-time SkiaSharp line chart that eases toward every new value and idles once it settles.
goals: A custom control drawn with SkiaSharp on SKCanvasElement, configured through dependency properties
Frame-driven animation on CompositionTarget.Rendering that detaches once the line settles
Smooth interpolation of the line, the value range and the badge toward each new value
A palette derived from one colour, a loading state and a live dot at the latest value
